blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-19"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", enforce = "preload" }

[stages.two]
unlock = "on_submit"

[stages.two.agent]
network = ["pypi.org"]

diagnostics.message: a set clock needs network = "none" while it runs, and [stages.two.agent] network is ["pypi.org"]: the network tells the real date (TLS, HTTP Date headers, package mirrors). Set [agent] network = "none"
